_comment: Ingredients matched here are discrete/countable items where a fractional scaled amount isn't practical to use. 'keyword' is matched as a whole word (plural allowed) against the ingredient part of each parsed name (before the first comma), so 'graham cracker' catches 'graham crackers' but not a crust 'made with graham cracker crumbs'. Eggs aren't here: they round in whole_items.json, with the measuring tip only when the count was rounded (flag wg7cv). Add entries as you run into more of these.

ingredients.note: Whole crackers/sheets don't split cleanly. Round to the nearest whole cracker, extra crumbs from a slightly-over amount are rarely a problem.
Gelatin sheets are discrete units. Round to the nearest whole sheet, sheet gelatin has some flex in practice.
